classification: Previously seen fixed-view projection check, not blind test
method: Native visual context plus mean RGB over x±2 columns; Gaussian sigma1 and vertical-gradient extrema. Lip outer boundary uses entrance/exit gradient of dark lip; inner uses reverse-sign transition. These are appearance edges, not exact mesh vertices.
limitations: Appearance-gradient inner transition is not identical to the approximately flat cream interior extent; both definitions are recorded.
Slot complete width and true object center are offscreen.
Vertical source readings vary with x due to perspective; do not infer world center from this one scanline.
